RBW and limit keyed to the measurement centre (measurement-receiver convention)
flat limit per offset region (step boundaries at 1 and 5 MHz, literal reading; no interpolation knots in the US rule)
in-channel unconstrained by the OOB table (0 dB rel, same in-channel treatment as the ETSI/flat arms)
